title: JBC releases shortlist for Deputy Ombudsman for Luzon
summary: The Judicial and Bar Council (JBC) on Monday released the shortlist of nominees for the position of Deputy Ombudsman for Luzon.

blocks.text: The Judicial and Bar Council (JBC) on Monday released the shortlist of nominees for the position of Deputy Ombudsman for Luzon.
In a letter dated October 26, the JBC submitted the following names to President Ferdinand "Bongbong" Marcos Jr.:

items: Palattao, Rodolfo John Robert Castillo, IV

blocks.text: The post was vacated by Cornelio Somido, whose term ended on August 27.

Under the Constitution, the Ombudsman and his deputies shall be appointed by the President from a list of at least six nominees prepared by the JBC and from a list of three nominees for every vacancy thereafter.
The appointments will require no confirmation. — BM, GMA News
